invariants: Original RadioInputType::NextRadioButtonInGroup supplies membership, including disabled/hidden and externally form-associated nodes. The original group data keeps form and tree scopes separate; empty names remain independent application controls.
Original DOMNodeIds::IdForNode and weak NodeForId supply stable engine identities. Native control IDs are separate fresh object lifetimes, so detach/reinsert cannot reuse a retired remote ID.

The shared RadioBinding cache owns only item data, typed native state, focus identity and host epochs. A live group owns one original native matrix; members do not create individual native radio buttons.

Original native cell sizing and member rectangles supply all matrix geometry. Native member bitmaps supply normal/disabled/checked/focused pixels. No drawing, selection, focus navigation or tracking algorithm is copied.

Native typed input chooses selected and key identities independently. Original Element::Focus and trusted Node::DispatchSimulatedClick own DOM focus, preactivation, events, cancellation and rollback. IDs and membership are revalidated after callbacks.

Native member pixels remain readable during tracking at unchanged native cell bounds; attempts to change layout while tracking are refused. The same engine-neutral host path is available to later adapters.

Current browser toolbar, address bar and tabs remain original. Only the small separate candidate adapter was rebuilt; all 20 production hashes, AppKit and the candidate 520-byte shared libraries remain unchanged.
